Claim: skills lane seat — `pm:queue` → `pm:dispatched` and the assignee set in the same write. Dispatching one os-dev flight on the ruling above (comment 5494466874); nothing is re-decided here.
Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01LraLgQVGq8egUwfYZpbYt1
Branch: `claude/issue-14047-clause2-classes`
Clause-②: no — protocol text under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/`; no platform accept/reject behaviour and no public surface moves. Clause ① applies (a tier-mandated governed surface): the dev runs at the standard tier and the seat reviews the delivery in-seat at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` before any human review is requested.

Scope, exactly the ruling: land in `references/contract-review.md` (1) the claim-time `Clause-②` declaration is provisional by design — the real gate is the at-tier review at PR/report time, and an overturned declaration is the mechanism working, not a seat fault; (2) the mechanical floor — any new exported symbol, or any new key on a published payload, is always `yes` at claim time; (3) the conformance class (populating an already-declared field, re-selecting between published codes) is not mechanized — when the claim cannot tell, dispatch as `yes` at the contract-review tier. ⛔ No taxonomy, no decision procedure, no reopening of the four specimen PRs, no other file.

Line ratchet: the file sits at its 60-line ceiling with headroom 0. Pay by deleting duplicate or demotable lines inside the same file first (a re-wrap is not payment); only if no content can be found does the ruling's own clause apply — 「若触行数天花板,按 #13900 裁决同型引用本评论提额」 — quoted verbatim and untranslated in the raising PR body and beside the row in `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`. `check:pm-skill-id-lint` forbids bare issue ids inside the reference file itself. Governed surface ⇒ draft PR, first line `Fixes #14047`; review requests are the seat's step.

## Seat review — **ACCEPT** (clause ① in-seat at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`; `Clause-②: no`)

PR #14696, head `f9991750`, `Fixes #14047`. Verified on the branch head, not from the PR body:

- **The ruling, and only the ruling, lands** in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md`: two bullets in 载体纪律 directly after 适用性 — (3) the claim-time `Clause-②` declaration is provisional by design, the real gate is the at-tier review at PR/report time, and being overturned there is the mechanism working, not a seat fault; the narrow half of (1) as a mechanical floor — any new exported symbol or new key on an already-published payload is `yes` at claim, checkable in the tree; the conformance class (populating a declared field, re-selecting between two published codes) stays un-mechanized and dispatches as `yes` when the claim cannot tell. The full taxonomy and the claim-time decision procedure are declined, as ruled. SKILL.md untouched; the four specimen PRs untouched.
- **Line arithmetic**: 60 → 65, headroom 0. The −2 is real deletion, not re-wrap: the 放行 bullet's FAIL / 卡在决策 triple (single source `SKILL.md:775-776`, the 条款②入队闸门 this file's header already points at) and the 三样不变 clause (its governed limb survives in-file at 落地前检三条 `:47`; the fuse has its own section `:53`). The residual +5 is line-quantized — the ruled text is 773 bytes against the gate's 120-byte line cap, so 7 lines is the floor — and the ceiling row goes 60 → 65 under the ruling's own clause, quoted verbatim and untranslated with its comment id beside the row and in the PR body: 「若触行数天花板,按 #13900 裁决同型引用本评论提额」. No table row (pin 0 untouched); `check:pm-skill-id-lint` 0 bare ids; the ruling is cited by date and quoted words in the reference itself.
- **Clause ① PASS**: the served model read via `get_session` at 19:0xZ equals the constant on `main`; the landed text states the three ruled clauses without widening either limb.
- **CI**: every check on `f9991750` green by 19:1xZ (Lint & Repo Gates, Type Check ×4 + rollup, Test Core 6/6 + rollup, the three claim guards, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, Check Documentation Links).
- The dev's own retraction is on record (a `premise_false` about the missing claim comment was a first-page read artifact; superseded by report comment 5514841547 and corrected in the PR body). The reading hazard it exposed — the zero-quota payload page carries only the first timeline page — is already recorded by #13385 / #13373 (held on #13597), so no new card. The `SKILL.md` 「假申报」 wording tension the PR body records goes to the seat ledger as a Phase-2 rider candidate, not a card.

Landing: governed (`.claude/**` + `scripts/pm/**`) ⇒ PR stays **draft**; review requested from os-zhuang + hotlong. At merge the seat strips `pm:dispatched`.
